info.description: The Adopted Pets Retrieval API allows users to access information about pets that have been adopted through the system. This endpoint provides data on previously adopted pets, including details such as type, breed, and adoption status. Typical consumers of this API include shelters and adoption agencies looking to track or showcase successful adoptions. By utilizing this API, organizations can efficiently manage their pet adoption records and analyze trends in pet adoption.
